status_contract.rule: Missing prerequisites or an unstarted prescribed action keeps execution_status=not_tested with result/evidence null. An attempted but unfinished probe uses execution_status=blocked with result null and non-empty redacted structured evidence. Only execution_status=completed may carry one capability result: 可用, 受限 or 不可用.

probes.scope_boundary: This Day-1 result covers only the marked temporary document. The final deliverable document requires a separate anonymous first-load and refresh recheck and cannot inherit this result.
probes.fallback_path: Keep a login-only document opening note plus separately accepted public site/video; P01 and the D0 anonymous-document gate remain incomplete.

probes.contract_boundary: Any formula, helper field, form or automation created by this capability probe stays in the isolated temporary Base and is not part of the frozen 10-table contract or import plan.
probes.fallback_path: Use ordinary fields, protected views and an explicit human checklist only within the observed limit; do not change the canonical contract or call the Base core complete.

checks.fallback_path: Keep selector resolution manual and stop R10 automatic projection; do not broaden the selector or prefill a record ID.
Set execution_mode=insufficient and use the documented manual reopen path; the offline projector remains solution design only.
Keep verification_status=not_tested and execution_mode=insufficient until P02+P03 are both complete.

pre_build_capability_check.purpose: Use isolated minimal views to verify that a non-owner identity and a deny boundary can be exercised before formal construction starts.
pre_build_capability_check.allowed_decision: May open the controlled build branch only when the observed boundary is safe. Before this phase starts, parent P03 remains not_tested/null/null. Once any prescribed prebuild action is attempted, parent P03 becomes blocked with result null and non-empty redacted evidence canonically bound to evidence_index; even a completed prebuild phase cannot complete P03.

post_build_five_view_recheck.purpose: After all five business views and protections exist, repeat the full anonymous-independent non-owner boundary test.
post_build_five_view_recheck.allowed_decision: Only this phase plus complete redacted evidence may determine the final P03 capability state.

probes.fallback_path: Use the smallest tested collaborator scope or a redacted copy with an opening note; if safe isolation cannot be demonstrated, do not share the main Base and keep D0 incomplete.

checks.fallback_path: Hide the raw field completely and keep R10 execution_mode=insufficient; do not add a helper field, sixth view or eleventh table.

Before complete P02+P03 evidence exists, keep verification_status=not_tested and execution_mode=insufficient; if the probe has run but capability is limited, record only the probe capability result as "受限" and never write verification_status=restricted.

probes.fallback_path: Use the seven-node contracts as manual worksheets and record only manual-fallback evidence; this does not count as node runtime evidence.
Use protected status fields, filtered views, an ordered human checklist and append-only audit; do not claim six workflow runtime evidence.

independent_outcomes.rule: Capability consumption may be true while business commit is false and business or W6 durable writes remain zero; record both outcomes separately.

batch_d1_observation_action_contract.excluded_action_history_rule: Committed recurrence-reopen history may be read as an authoritative checkpoint source, but D1 does not expose or execute archive or reopen actions.

probes.fallback_path: Use protected confirmation status, reviewer and review-time fields verified again under P03; never bypass a required human gate.

batch_d1_approval_contract.separate_transaction_rule: No Day7 or Day30 checkpoint is created or committed in the enter_observation authorization transaction.

probes.fallback_path: Use the tested Base notification, mention or human duty checklist; the bot is not a core single point.
Use the Base knowledge_index table and stop N7 when no approved effective source exists.
Return to the five Base views. Miaoda is D1 and cannot replace D0.
Omit the D2 conversation entry and retain the Base core, seven node contracts and six workflow contracts.
Do not enable external access; use forms, native import and manual import. Keep P12 and P13 not tested when their prerequisites are absent.
Use forms, native import or reviewed manual import; OpenAPI remains non-core and disabled.
Use the Feishu interface and offline/fake project tools; lark-cli is D1 and cannot replace D0.
